notes.title: Pieces of the Past is taking part in the Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're really excited to announce that [b]Pieces of the Past is taking part in the Steam Next Fest: June 2025 Edition![/b]

We've [b]majorly overhauled the demo[/b] and the entire visual style of the game. We're really looking forward to your feedback, and will continue to improve the game by taking all of it into account. You can use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2786650/discussions/]Steam Discussions forum[/url] to leave comments!

[b]The June 2025 edition of Next Fest runs June 9 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to June 16 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7). [/b]

notes.title: Updated Demo for Women's Day Steam Sale!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very excited to announce that Pieces of the Past is taking part in the Women's Day Steam Sale! To celebrate our participation in this great event, we now have an updated demo available on our Steam page.

The new demo features [b]overhauled and improved visuals[/b], and now includes the [b]antique shop[/b] as a hub for the puzzles.

Try out the demo now, and please give us your feedback by leaving a review on the demo page, or using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2786650/discussions/]Steam Discussions forum[/url].

notes.title: Pieces of the Past is taking part in the Wholesome Games Celebration event!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're super excited to announce that Pieces of the Past will be among the games taking part in the Wholesome Games Celebration! During the event, [b]we will release a public demo for the first time![/b] Repair and clean different items and experience a portion of the story in the demo!

We hope you enjoy our demo while we're hard at working on developing the game and the story! We're looking forward to your feedback, as this will be the first time we are releasing a public demo! Please leave your feedbacks on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2786650/discussions/]Steam Discussions forum[/url]!

We want to thank the Wholesome Games team for giving us this amazing opportunity. Make sure to check out all the other amazing games in the Wholesome Games Celebration event by clicking the link below!

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames[/url][/b]

If you've enjoyed our demo and want to keep up with updates, [b]please wishlist the game![/b] Wishlists support us massively and let us know you're interested in the game.
